test_title: PYST 39: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 21 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which the folded paper has been cut is shown in the following figures. How would this paper look when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fee4137a7733822d88dabd33a6f0aec9ec8fc068d9034510c1f7db7ea2f5c90.png]
solution:
The paper is folded initially into half. Then, that folded paper is folded into another half. Then, cutouts are made.

When, the paper is unfolded, the cutout should appear at four places, where 2 cutouts are formed on the upper part and two inverted cutouts are formed on the lower part. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1c9fb6423c27492dc65fd343d9493b5b7e47a13aacc263d5061471fa5dd4738.png] 

This can only be seen in option 1. 

Thus, option 1 is correct.
